attempts.rationale: The probe sets up a public repository, grants a collaborator admin access, and performs a repo read with that collaborator to warm any per-session role cache. It then uses A's DELETE revoke route to remove the collaborator and, in the same session, has the revoked collaborator attempt an admin-only action. In world A, requirePermission evaluates roles fresh on every request, so the post-revoke request is denied with 403. In world A+B, B's per-session role cache still holds the stale admin role, so the same request is allowed with 201, causing the 403 assertion to fail. The probe reports n/a when the revoke route is absent by checking for Hono's default text/plain 404 Not Found response, and it also fails if A's revoke does nothing because the collaborator would then still be authorized in world A.
